Spellbook is the most comprehensive AI copilot for transactional lawyers. It works directly inside Microsoft Word to help legal teams draft, review, and negotiate contracts up to 10x faster and with greater precision. Today, more than 4,000 law firms, in-house teams, and solo practitioners rely on Spellbook to simplify their workflows and eliminate the drudgery of everyday contract work. 

We are backed by leading investors including Khosla Ventures, Thomson Reuters Ventures, Inovia Capital, The LegalTech Fund, Bling Capital, and Moxxie Ventures. The company recently raised $50 million in Series B funding, led by Keith Rabois at Khosla Ventures, bringing its total funding to more than $80 million.



*This is an existing vacancy




ABOUT THE ROLE



The Spellbook brand team is seeking a Brand Design Lead to shape how we show up across touchpoints, from sales material and digital experiences to events and in-person activations. You’ll own projects end to end, from concept through delivery, and set the standard for craft across information-dense deliverables like decks and one-pagers. You’ll also lead the development of generative brand systems and AI tooling that scale output across the company.



We’re a team that cares deeply about iteration and quality, and strives for impact in every project. We don’t operate as a service desk, but as a strategic partner to Product, Marketing, Sales, and leaders across the company. You’ll join a small, focused team of creatives with low ego and high standards. We believe that quality and speed are not opposing forces, but together create conditions to build momentum.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own brand projects end to end, from creative direction and concept through production and delivery

 - Lead experiential and in-person brand work, including events, conferences, and activations, from spatial concept to on-site execution

 - Build generative AI brand tools and workflows that increase the speed and quality of brand work across the company

 - Prototype and ship digital brand experiences, working directly in code when it moves the work forward

 - Shape the evolution of Spellbook’s brand system, defining standards that hold up across digital, print, and physical spaces

 - Set the bar for sales enablement materials like decks, one-pagers, and templates

 - Partner with Sales, Product Marketing, Customer Success, and leadership to set priorities and move work forward

 - Work closely with our Creative Director, mentor other designers, and lead regular critiques

 - Other responsibilities as required




WHAT YOU NEED

 - 7+ years of experience in a brand, graphic design, or related role, including leading projects from concept to delivery

 - A portfolio that shows strong skill in brand systems, editorial layout of information-dense materials, and digital or experiential work

 - Excellent attention to typography, hierarchy, and composition

 - Hands-on experience building custom AI tooling, generative systems, or automated workflows to scale brand work

 - Comfort working with AI to prototype  ideas and ship digital work

 - Proficiency in Figma, the Adobe suite, and other presentation tools like Google Slides

 - Experience owning events or physical activations, including working with vendors, fabricators, and budgets

 - Comfort managing multiple projects and deadlines while setting direction for others

 - An appetite for collaboration and critique in pursuit of highly crafted, impactful work




NICE-TO-HAVES

 - Experience at a small studio or in an independent practice

 - Motion design or short-form video editing experience in tools like Jitter

 - Experience with creative coding, generative design, or interactive installations

 - Illustration skills




WHY JOIN SPELLBOOK?

 - Embrace autonomy and accountability in a flexible work environment; we focus on outcomes and empower you to determine how to get the job done

 - Access our company-paid group benefits for you and your family, with $1,000 towards mental health support

 - Disconnect during our holiday closure and take advantage of our generous time off policies throughout the year

 - Enjoy monthly paid meals, an annual wellness allowance to support your well-being and parental leave top-ups as your family grows

 - Secure your stake in our success; you’ll receive competitive stock option grants as a pivotal early employee






INCLUSIVE HIRING AT SPELLBOOK

We are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive candidate experience. Should you require any accommodation whatsoever during the interview process, please inform us without any hesitation. Spellbook is dedicated to ensuring equal treatment and opportunity in all phases of recruitment, selection, and employment, in compliance with employment law. We do not discriminate based on gender, race, religion, national origin, ethnicity, disability, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other protected category. Spellbook is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, fostering a culture of inclusivity and maintaining a work environment that is free from discrimination, harassment, and retaliation.




USE OF ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE IN RECRUITMENT

Spellbook uses artificial intelligence (AI) responsibly to support administrative and efficiency-focused aspects of our recruitment process. This includes activities such as drafting job descriptions, generating interview questions, note-taking and recordings, and supporting sourcing and scheduling workflows. All candidate evaluations, interviews, and hiring decisions are made by members of the Spellbook team. While AI tools may assist with screening and assessment, they do not replace human judgment in selection decisions. Our use of AI is intended to streamline routine tasks, improve consistency, and enhance the overall candidate experience. We are committed to upholding principles of fairness, transparency, and accountability in all hiring activities. Spellbook regularly reviews its recruitment practices to mitigate bias and to ensure alignment with applicable laws and evolving best practices.




OUR COMPENSATION PHILOSOPHY

Spellbook uses industry benchmark data to establish compensation bands for all roles. The salary range listed for a position reflects the expected total wage range for the role—including base salary and on-target commissions, where applicable—and may span multiple career levels. Final compensation is determined during the interview process based on factors such as experience, skills, scope, and role level. In addition to base salary and applicable commissions, total rewards may include equity, health and wellness benefits, and other company programs. Full details will be shared during the interview process.

samples.description:
At Kepler Communications, we're not just imagining the future of on-demand space connectivity - we're leading it! Our mission is to provide real-time on-orbit connectivity for critical missions, enabling a new era of data-driven intelligence and innovation. With 33 satellites launched to date, Kepler operates the first commercial optical data relay constellation, enabling real-time, continuous space communications while supporting advanced on-orbit compute and hosted payload capabilities.  Industry-leading technology is only part of the story. What sets Kepler apart is our team: bold thinkers, skilled builders, and passionate problem-solvers who thrive on pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in space. We believe great ideas come from diverse perspectives, and we’re committed to creating an environment where you can grow, lead, and make a global impact.    If you’re ready to reach higher, move faster, and do work that shapes the future space economy - this is your launchpad. Come build the future with Kepler!      What We Offer: * Competitive compensation with a robust equity plan to share in our success.  * Comprehensive coverage for health, dental, and vision insurance—including dependents.  * Unlimited vacation, supportive parental leave policy, and company-wide holiday shutdown.  * Semi-annual company-wide parties and frequent in-office team events.  * Relocation packages available for approved roles.  * $1,500 annual professional development fund to support your growth.  * Fully stocked Toronto office kitchen with snacks, drinks, games and top-notch kitchen appliances.  * Town Halls, Celebration Calls, and Company-wide events to stay connected and engaged.  * We’re a certified Great Place to Work®, seven years in a row! Please be prepared to share portfolio, Github, etc. in advance to the recruiter welcome call   We are looking for an Electrical Design Automation Engineer to accelerate how Kepler designs, analyzes, and verify the electronics inside our satellites. You are an electrical engineer who understands the complete board-development lifecycle—from schematic capture and layout through bring-up, debugging, and verification. Along the way, you have likely found yourself writing scripts or building tools to eliminate repetitive work, improve consistency, and catch problems earlier. In this role you will own the Altium component library, develop automation, and then build and integrate scripted and AI-assisted tools across our electrical design and analysis workflows for years to come.   This is a hands-on individual contributor role, working alongside our electrical, FPGA, RF, software, and test engineers where you will combine practical electrical engineering judgment with programming and automation to build tools that engineers can trust, maintain, and use over time.  Key Responsibilities

  • Own the Altium Designer component library for Kepler's electrical team: part creation, symbol and footprint standards, lifecycle and parameter data, and supplier/ERP linkage. Then automate it. The expectation is that within your first six months the librarian's work is largely handled by tooling you built, reviewed, and documented

  • Establish the framework by which AI-assisted and automated tools are developed and maintained at Kepler: coding standards, code review, version control, testing and regression suites, deployment, monitoring, documentation, and a clear owner for every tool. Define the standard lifecycle for using AI-based tools at Kepler, and the baseline for AI acceleration in hardware engineering

  • Produce AI-driven integrations through the Altium API to help real-time detection of design issues and errors, and integrate relevant checks and analysis into schematic and layout workflows

  • Map Kepler's electrical design and analysis workflow —including library management, schematic capture, layout, design reviews, derating, power budgets, reliability, FMECA, BOM management, and documentation— to identify where scripted or AI-driven tooling removes the most engineering hours or the most defects

  • Design, build, and maintain engineering tools using Altium API, Python and scripting, LLM-based assistants and agents, data pipelines, with integrations into Kepler’s PLM, version control, and documentation systems

  • Treat generated tools as a product with a defined lifecycle: gather requirements from the engineers who will use it, ship a minimum version, measure adoption and impact, improve it based on feedback, and maintain it as Altium, engineering models, and internal processes evolve   

  • Evaluate emerging EDA, AI, and engineering-automation tools, trial promising solutions, and recommend what to build versus buy

  • As the electrical design flow matures, extend this approach into electrical test automation, data analysis, report generation and other hardware-engineering workflows  

  • Participate in active design reviews to identify design gaps and to learn where tooling could have caught them earlier

  • Support engineering analyses such as derating, power budgets, reliability, thermal, and FMECA, and build the tooling that makes them faster, more repeatable, and easier to review Maintain thorough technical documentation for every tool and framework you deliver design decisions, interfaces, usage guides, and change history 

    • Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Computer Engineering, or related discipline, or equivalent practical experience

  • 4+ years of hardware design experience, including at least several board-development cycles involving schematic capture, PCB layout or close layout oversight, bring-up, testing and debugging of boards built around microcontrollers, FPGAs, or SoCs or comparable digital and mixed-signal devices

  • Working proficiency in Altium Designer, including its library and component-management workflow

  • Programming experience in Python or a comparable language applied to engineering problems such as scripting, data handling, tool building, or test automation. You do not need to be a software engineer, but you must be able to write maintainable code that other engineers can understand, review, and run  

  • Hands-on experience building with LLMs or AI coding tools and a clear point of view on where they help, where they fail, and how to check their output

  • Evidence of having developed a tool or automation that others used over time.  This may be demonstrated through a portfolio, repository, or sanitized work sample of the tool’s lifecycle with version history, tests, documentation, change logs, user feedback, or handover notes. We will ask you to explain how the tool was developed, adopted, maintained, and transferred to others

  • A credible strategy for keeping automation sustainable, including how you decide what to build, review and version the work as well as how you keep it repeatable as inputs and models change and transfers ownership

  • Strong listening and stakeholder skills where you identify engineers’ underlying needs, and translate them into practical solutions, o and incorporate feedback from domain specialists 

    • Bonus Points

  • Experience performing and documenting engineering analyses such as worst-case analysis, derating, thermal, reliability, FMECA, power budgets, or EMI/EMC.  These are among the first workflows you will be automating

  • Significant Altium API or scripting experience (Altium scripting, Altium 365 API, DelphiScript/JScript, or Python wrappers), or automation of another EDA tool (KiCad, OrCAD, Cadence)

  • Experience with the broader toolchain including Git-based workflows, CI/CD, containerization, PLM/ERP integration, and documentation systems

  • Experience building LLM application frameworks, agents, retrieval over engineering documents, or MCP-style tool integrations

  • Electrical or hardware test automation experience including instrument control, test sequencers, test data pipelines

  • Experience designing electronics for space, aerospace, or other high-reliability environments

  • Experience in a small engineering company or startup where you owned significant portions of the board-development lifecycle

  • Exposure to high-speed digital or mixed-signal design (DDR, Ethernet, PCIe, ADC/DAC signal chains) and the signal-integrity and timing checks that go with it

  • Comfort working in a rapid-learning, hardware environment where requirements continue to evolve

As Senior Product Manager, Payments Gateway, you will own Versapay’s payment gateways: the platform every Versapay payment flows through, from authorization to settlement.  You will set the vision and roadmap for a modular, scalable, multi-tenant gateway that connects Versapay’saccounts receivable products to processors, acquirers, and card & bank networks. You ownboth the product and business outcomes for the gateways; authorization and payment success rates, uptime and latency, downgrades, cost per transaction, and more.  This is a platform role. Your customers are Versapay’s product teams, our core processing partners, the developers and ERP partners who integrate with us, and the ledger and finance teams who depend on every payment landing correctly. You will partner directly with engineering on architecture and delivery, work with go-to-market teams on positioning and regularly represent gateway strategy and performance to senior leadership, influencing direction and investment.  This is an opportunity for a product leader who has built/scaled a payment gateway and is ready to grow and modernize a global B2B payments platform.  What You'll Do:

  • Drive payment performance. Own the gateway’s core KPIs: authorization and payment success rates, decline and retry performance, uptime, latency, and processing cost. Improve them through connection optimization, failover, smart retries, network tokenization, account updater, 3DS and authentication flows, and B2B card data (Level 2/3). 

  • Build the platform others build on. Define the gateway’s APIs, SDKs, hosted payment pages, webhooks, and merchant and MID configuration so Versapay product teams and partners can launch new payment experiences in days, not quarters.

Join a Challenger At EQ, we're remaking banking so every Canadian gets ahead, every day. Serving nearly 4 million Canadians from coast to coast, we offer a wide variety of financial services from banking and lending, to trust and credit union solutions.  We've been at this since 1970, challenging the conventions of traditional banking with smarter, faster, and more connected financial experiences. What's kept us moving?  The people behind it all: challengers who ask better questions, push back on old assumptions, and look for a better way forward. If you're driven to help reshape how banking works for Canadians and the businesses that power our economy, this could be your next big opportunity.  We can’t wait to get to know you!  Work Term: January - August 2027 Ready to shape the future of banking? Join the purpose-driven, tech-forward team at Equitable Bank where your ideas matter and your growth is accelerated. We’re not just another bank—we’re Canada’s Challenger Bank™, lean, agile, and built for the digital age. If you’re passionate about challenging the status quo, driving meaningful change, and gaining hands-on experience in digital financial services, our Engineering Internship Program is the opportunity you’ve been waiting for!  Starting in January 2027, you’ll begin your journey as a Software Engineer Intern through our Engineering Graduate Program, designed to accelerate your development through immersive, hands-on experience within Digital Banking.  At EQ Bank, we’re building the future of banking in Canada, and we want you to be part of it! Our teams work in agile, cross-functional pods where collaboration, creativity, and innovation drive everything we do. We put customers at the heart of every decision, using research, data, and feedback to create products that truly make an impact. We’re not just building software, we’re reimagining banking. If you’re passionate about solving real-world problems, learning from experienced engineers, and working in a supportive, dynamic environment, this program is for you!    The Core Responsibilities of the Job
Over the course of this 8-month term, you’ll have the opportunity to work with frontend and backend tools and projects. 
Your responsibilities will include:

  • Backend:

  • Assess and clarify user experience and requirements to deliver customer-centric solutions. 
  • Analyze functional requirements and provide technical solutions, including API designs and Microservice architecture. 
  • Develop and support RESTful/SOAP APIs and Microservice applications. 
  • Participate in SCRUM meetings to ensure smooth Sprint delivery and issue resolution. 
  • Conduct unit testing and assist with automated testing where applicable. 
  • Participate in code reviews and manage merge requests for various release branches. 
  • Collaborate with incident management teams to troubleshoot and resolve production incidents. 
  • Contribute to technical documentation and assist with ongoing application support

    • Frontend:

  • Design and develop user interfaces following modern best practices and technologies (e.g., Angular, Java/Kotlin for Android, SwiftUI for iOS). 
  • Write clean, maintainable, and performant code using the relevant programming languages and frameworks for web and mobile platforms. 
  • Make key technical and design decisions to ensure effective and efficient user interfaces. 
  • Develop and integrate frontend applications with RESTful APIs and GraphQL. 
  • Collaborate with senior developers to implement performant, scalable solutions for both web and mobile platforms. 
  • Provide application support and perform code reviews to maintain quality standards

    • Why EQB? What's in it for you?

  • If you're a 4th year student looking to launch your career in a dynamic, purpose-driven environment, this is your opportunity to build a strong foundation and make a real impact. 

    • At EQ Bank you will receive: 

  • Mentorship & Coaching: from senior leaders and subject matter experts. Our Mentorship program is structured to provide regular touchpoints, feedback, and personalized guidance to help you thrive.  Be a part of leadership round table discussions and hear from experts across Engineering to help you network and build connections. 
  • Empowerment and Impact: Opportunities to make a difference and create lasting impact through meaningful work, empowering you to contribute directly to business outcomes while developing the skills and confidence to grow your career in Digital Banking.
  • Chart your Career Path:  Final year students who perform successfully in this program will have the opportunity to achieve a full-time role at the end of their work term! 
    • Let's Talk About You!
  • Must be a student currently enrolled in school
  • Undergraduate/Bachelors degree in Computer Science or Software Engineering 
  • Experience developing software using modern programming languages and frameworks in a professional environment or internship.
  • Understanding of modern application architectures and interest in scalable distributed systems, including designing, implementing, and maintaining microservice-based architectures. 
  • Basic knowledge of REST API and Microservices architecture patterns. 
  • Experience with MSSQL or other relational databases. 
  • Development experience with JUnit and Spring integration tests. 
  • Basic knowledge of Git for version control. 
  • Self-starter who can take a concept and drive it through to design and implementation. 
  • Ability to carry out other technical-related duties as needed. 
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and tools to automate the development, testing, and deployment process. 
  • Experience with Angular, Java/Kotlin for Android, or SwiftUI for iOS in a professional environment. 
  • Android development with tools like RxJava, Coroutines, Flow, and Compose
  • iOS development using SwiftUI, RxSwift, Swift Concurrency, and some familiarity with Objective-C. 
  • Proficiency in JavaScript, with experience in Angular, CSS, HTML, and writing cross-browser compatible code for web development. 
  • Understanding of RESTful Architecture, GraphQL, and web services. 
  • Familiarity with security frameworks, standards, and practices. 
  • Knowledge of Micro Frontend architecture (preferred).
  • Experience with experience with AI-enhanced development (an asset)

  • In ONE document, please submit your transcript and resume. Failure to do so will result in your application not being considered.

At Kepler Communications, we're not just imagining the future of on-demand space connectivity - we're leading it!   Our mission is to provide real-time on-orbit connectivity for critical missions, enabling a new era of data-driven intelligence and innovation. With 33 satellites launched to date, Kepler operates the first commercial optical data relay constellation, enabling real-time, continuous space communications while supporting advanced on-orbit compute and hosted payload capabilities.    Industry-leading technology is only part of the story. What sets Kepler apart is our team: bold thinkers, skilled builders, and passionate problem-solvers who thrive on pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in space. We believe great ideas come from diverse perspectives, and we’re committed to creating an environment where you can grow, lead, and make a global impact.    If you’re ready to reach higher, move faster, and do work that shapes the future space economy - this is your launchpad. Come build the future with Kepler!        What We Offer: - Build and operate real satellites!  - Get hands-on with cutting-edge space technology and real-world engineering challenges.  - Dedicated mentorship to support your learning and growth.  - Fun and collaborative work environment where you'll learn quickly and feel supported.  - Team-building events and opportunities to connect across the company.  - Fully stocked Toronto office kitchen with snacks, drinks, games, and top-notch kitchen appliances.  - Frequent in-office and company-wide events to stay connected and engaged.  - Make a direct impact on Kepler's growth and success.  - We’re a certified Great Place to Work® seven years in a row.  We’re on the hunt for a top-tier Software Engineering Intern who will assist in developing and maintaining high-performance backend services and infrastructure. You will work closely with cross-functional teams such as satellite operations, ground stations and software development to build scalable applications that support the development, testing, and operation of our satellites and mission control software. You will be trusted from day-one to get hands on with the breadth of our software stack. Responsibilities:
  • Support design and development of reliable, high-quality software related to operating Kepler’s satellite network infrastructure and mission control software automation 
  • Collaborate with satellite operators and product managers to deliver mission critical ground systems 
  • Writing thorough tests and documentation 
  • Participating in software design review and code review processes 
    • Required Skills and Qualifications:
  • Enrolled in Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent 
  • Prior internship experience using Python to develop back end services 
  • Prior experience supporting software development and test writing 
  • Excellent communication skills 
  • Demonstrated willingness and ability to leverage AI-assisted engineering and development tools to improve productivity, design quality, and innovation while adapting to evolving technologies and best practices
  • Currently enrolled in a post-secondary program and returning to studies after the internship
  • Available for a full-time internship beginning Jan 2027 for 4-16 months.
  • Opportunity to work out of our new Toronto office! This position can be based onsite at our Toronto office (24 Ward Street), or hybrid.
    • Bonus Points:
  • Ability to effectively use git 
  • Familiarity in SQL and/or NoSQL databases and data design (PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, etc.) 
  • Familiarity with containerized software (Kubernetes, K8s) and infrastructure-as-code (Ansible, Terraform, etc.)
